ev.q: Forty-three of the 46 responding states and DC (94%) and all seven cities indicated having reporting requirements
Forty-one states and DC (89%) had the capacity to receive disease reports primarily by telephone
31 states and DC (68%) reported they would use the CDC laboratory
For the seven large cities, the patterns for receiving and investigating reports were similar.
In 2005, CSTE conducted a cross-sectional survey in the United States and its territories
